releaseNotes:
1. Three-Level GIS Hierarchy: Upgraded data architecture to 'Imported Files → Line Sections → Feeders'. Independent Line Section creation (+ New Section) with full database persistence, duplicate name protection, renaming, and safe deletion options.
2. Feeder-Specific Display Colors: Every feeder has its own assigned display color applied across tower markers, polylines (with high-contrast casing), right drawer indicator, and interactive floating map legend; includes 24-color curated palette and HSV picker.
3. Section-Level & Feeder-Level View/Hide: Toggling Section eye icon instantly hides/restores all child feeder lines and markers while strictly preserving individual feeder visibility states; live section color summary dots in drawer.
4. Migration & Section Assignment: Dedicated 'Assign Feeders to Sections' helper dialog allows one-click batch assignment of historical or unassigned feeders to sections; KMZ/KML import enhanced with target section selector.
5. Active Feeder Selection & Moving: Feeder context menu includes 'Move to Another Section'; explicit active feeder requirement prevents accidental misassignment of newly created tower markers.

previousStableRelease.releaseNotes:
1. External Google Maps Navigation from Marker Balloon Tip: Added small, prominent 'Navigate' button inside the compact tower marker balloon tip with Google Maps-style navigation icon; one-tap launches Google Maps app (or web browser fallback) with exact tower coordinates as destination in driving travel mode.
2. Marker Options Sheet & Popup Menu Integration: 'Navigate in Google Maps' also accessible via the balloon three-dot popup menu and Marker Options bottom sheet for comprehensive accessibility from both map and right feeder drawer.
3. Robust Coordinate Validation & Tap Debouncing: Coordinates are strictly validated (finite, valid lat/lng boundaries, non-zero) and protected with tap-debouncing cooldown to eliminate accidental double launches; alphanumeric Location Numbers (31A, 4T, 10/1T) preserved.
4. Real-Time OTA CDN Invalidation: Manifest checks updated with cache-busting headers and query parameters to guarantee instant OTA update detection on devices without CDN or proxy delays.
